description: React component for the OrderPage in an e-commerce application, connected to Redux store, responsible for fetching and displaying order details, handling loading state, and navigation.

classes.name: OrderPage
classes.description: React component class for displaying order details, managing lifecycle events for fetching data, and rendering order information or not found message.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that fetches order data when the component mounts, using the order ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that refetches order data if the order ID in URL parameters changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the order page, showing a loading indicator, order details, or a not found message based on the current state.
